display_name: The whole Computer Misuse Act 1993 (ss 1-20, First and Second Schedules) under one top-level goal — is the conduct reached, is the offence made out, and what is the most it can cost — and four goals: definitions, offences, punishment, reach and procedure
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 07 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition with Act 16 of 2023 and Act 21 of 2025). The top-level goal refuses conduct before 30 December 2025 (fork F1). Inert (carried as text): the long title, s 1, s 20. Inputs: the court's findings (knowledge, purpose, intent, reasonable steps, rebuttal of presumptions), prescribed compoundable offences, prescribed loss thresholds and devices. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-07 (tests-independent.l4; expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, in independent-expectations.md): 133 of 134 passed first time; the one disagreement (s 14 at exactly 12 months) was resolved by revising fork F2, and s 16/s 19 in the goal were decoupled from proof; triage in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md and NOTES.md section 4. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: Conduct before 30 December 2025 refuses at the top level (Act 21 of 2025; the earlier text is not in the source).
forks.F2: s 14(1)(c): the last act may fall on the anniversary of the first (first day excluded, Interpretation Act s 50(a)).
forks.F3: ss 3(2), 5(2), 6(2), 7(2): the damage ceiling applies whether or not a repeat conviction.
forks.F4: s 11(1): with a protected computer, $100,000 / 20 years in lieu of every limb, damage included.
forks.F5: s 12: abetment, attempt and preparation carry the offence's own punishment.

checks.command: l4 run <module> for every .l4 (stable l4, VS Code extension 1.6.98; JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset); ./check.sh gives the same counts
checks.returned_to_commons: 2026-10-21: REFUSE rewritten as an explicit NOTHING (not covered); see NOTES.md
